trap.label: paralelismo
trap.wrong: Doubt the table, doubt the hand, doubt of the doubt.
trap.right: Doubt the table, doubt the hand, doubt even the doubt.
trap.why: Português “duvidar de”; em inglês doubt é transitivo, sem preposição.

mcq.q: Which line repeats the opening verb for insistence?
opts: Doubt the table, doubt the hand, doubt…

fix.wrong: Doubting the table, doubt the hand.
fix.right: Doubt the table, doubt the hand.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “Doubt the table, doubt the hand, doubt even ___.” (the doubt)
rewrite.answer: Doubt the table, doubt the hand, doubt even the doubt.
